summary: feat(settings): add utm_content to the v2 pairing QR URL
description:
Because:
- The v2 pairing QR URL has no campaign tag for scans.

This commit:
- Adds utm_content=DTM_SYNC_PAIR_V2 to the getPairUrl('2') URL, before the fragment.
- Keeps the v1 URL and the supplicant deep links unchanged.
- Covers v1 and v2 in the unit tests and asserts the tag in pairingFlowV2.spec.ts.

Closes FXA-14784
